build_equivariant_layer_norm: build an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize equivariant features of shape N sphere_basis C per degree
build_equivariant_layer_norm_sh: build an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 with LayerNorm and scale L>0 components together
build_equivariant_rms_norm_sh_v2: build an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to RMS normalize all spherical harmonic degrees with optional centering and degree balancing
build_equivariant_degree_layer_scale: build an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by degree with learnable affine weights
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type lmax and num_channels parameters
